title: Property tribunal finds agent breached Tenant Fees Act
summary:
A London Property Tribunal has ruled against a letting agent for illegally deducting money from a tenant's deposit, highlighting ongoing compliance issues with the Tenant Fees Act 2019 seven years after its introduction. The case adds to calls for stronger enforcement of existing regulations in the lettings sector.

title: UK property market narrows gap with 2024 performance
summary:
The UK property market showed signs of recovery in late July 2026, with weekly sales figures returning to 2024 levels after a difficult spring and early summer period. In week 30, 24,700 homes sold subject to contract, bringing net sales back in line with 2024 figures.

The post UK property market narrows gap with 2024 performance appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Letting agents urged to calculate landlord lifetime value
summary:
Letting agents are underestimating the long-term financial value of landlord clients by focusing on annual fees rather than lifetime revenue, according to compliance expert Karen Stanley. Most agents calculate a landlord's worth at approximately £1,200 annually, but lifetime value including referrals and portfolio growth could reach £15,000 to £25,000 or more.

The post Letting agents urged to calculate landlord lifetime value appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Landlord database may duplicate existing schemes, warns trade body
summary:
England's planned national landlord register could increase administrative burdens and costs without raising property standards, according to Propertymark. The database, scheduled for introduction later this year under the Renters' Rights Act, will require private landlords to register personal details and individual properties.

The post Landlord database may duplicate existing schemes, warns trade body appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Burnham’s capital gains tax proposal raises industry concerns
summary:
Andy Burnham has indicated support for increasing Capital Gains Tax rates to align with Income Tax levels, potentially raising rates from 24% to 45%. The proposal has prompted concerns from property sector professionals about impacts on business ownership and transaction activity.

The post Burnham’s capital gains tax proposal raises industry concerns appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Right to Buy sales surge 90% despite tighter criteria
summary:
Council home sales under the Right to Buy scheme in England increased by 90% in 2025 to 2026, reaching 14,275 properties, according to data from Moneyfacts. The surge occurred despite Housing Secretary Angela Rayner's earlier decision to reduce discounts available to council tenants.

The post Right to Buy sales surge 90% despite tighter criteria appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Property agencies urged to review lone-working safety
summary:
Property agencies across the UK are being urged to review their lone-working procedures following the 40th anniversary of estate agent Suzy Lamplugh's disappearance. Propertymark has updated its personal safety guidance, covering risk assessments, staff training and check-in systems.

The post Property agencies urged to review lone-working safety appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: PEXA and Mastercard to trial synchronised property payments
summary:
PEXA and Mastercard have announced a partnership to test programmable account-to-account payments designed to synchronise property ownership transfers with fund releases. The proposed system will be tested through Mastercard's A2A Sandbox, a platform where banks and partners can trial programmable payment applications.

title: New-build premium reaches 30% across Great Britain
summary:
New-build homes in Great Britain now command an average 30% price premium over existing properties, with the gap widening by 6.2 percentage points since 2016. Regional variations remain substantial, with the North East recording the largest premium at 60% above existing properties.

The post New-build premium reaches 30% across Great Britain appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Dwelly completes ninth acquisition with Kensington agency
summary:
Property management group Dwelly has acquired Kensington-based lettings agency Shaws, marking its ninth acquisition in 2026. The deal adds approximately 250 fully managed properties to Dwelly's portfolio, bringing the group's total properties under management to more than 14,000 nationwide.
